title: SG-10.2.1 Focused-object id field and setter in the game store
summary: Game store holds focusedObjectId and a setFocusedObject action, covered by unit tests
description: Context: game/frontend/src/store/gameStore.ts exports useGameStore with state, setState and init only. Desired behavior: add a focusedObjectId field (string or null) and a setFocusedObject action so keyboard focus can later be pushed into the scene. Expected result: both exist on the real store and are unit tested. Why: SG-10.2 needs a shared focus source of truth without duplicating state in Phaser or React.
acceptance_criteria: Given a fresh store, when focusedObjectId is read, then it is null
Given a fresh store, when setFocusedObject('bookshelf') is called, then focusedObjectId is 'bookshelf'
Given a focused object, when setFocusedObject(null) is called, then focusedObjectId is null
Given the existing store tests, when run, then init and setState behavior is unchanged
technical_constraints: Use the existing zustand store in game/frontend/src/store/gameStore.ts
Tests import the real store, not a mock
